name: Fixed-disk MSC/BOT/SCSI
comparison: Matched LIBM qualification profiles, feature switches, compiler, source epoch and source path. Flash counts include the sealed resident image; static RAM comes from the linker budget check.

classic.physical_MSC: PASS: binary 4096-byte import, exact CDC readback, reset, re-export, Unicode filename, two safe ejections, two CDC returns and exact cleanup
classic.preservation: PASS: every original file fingerprint, active program, registers, stack, IP and current directory

mini.physical_MSC: PASS: binary 4096-byte import, exact CDC readback, reset, re-export, Unicode filename, two safe ejections, two CDC returns and exact cleanup
mini.preservation: PASS: every original file fingerprint, active program, registers, stack, IP and current directory

validation.cross_MCU_WS0010_RAM: PASS: all four configured growth budgets
validation.protocol_tests: Production class/BOT/SCSI/inquiry/memory sources; fixed descriptors, exact reply bytes, READ/WRITE(10/12) chunking, deferred read/write/sync success and failure, reset/CDC lifetime rejection, malformed CBW/CDB, address/overflow bounds, sense ring overflow, MODE SENSE, locked/accepted/failed eject, capacity and endpoint-open cleanup
validation.controller_ARM: Production Classic, mini and F401 A00 controller register models PASS
validation.control_ARM: Actual control/descriptor/queue engine with Classic, mini and F401 settings; 50000 queue transitions per setting PASS
validation.CDC_ARM: Production Classic class ACM/EP0 bounds/ZLP/NAK/rearm PASS
validation.runtime_ARM: Classic reset/clock/USB48/SysTick/DWT/STOP and mini qualified no-STOP profile PASS
validation.APP_RAM: Actual ELF retained reserves and guarded APP pool checks PASS; no stack/guard budget increase
validation.host: SCSI safety and memory policy; disk session; USB power and STOP; HIL transaction guards; full C9 storage with sanitizers; storage geometry and immutable FAT chains PASS
validation.physical_sleep: No new operator sleep test requested or armed; this phase changes MSC transport only. Earlier physical sleep results are not substituted for a new-image test.

observations.result: Initial baseline run failed this conservative target before any new mini image was installed. Exact cleanup/preservation passed; later observation and strict baseline repeat both measured 12544, as did the candidate. The initial failure is retained in raw evidence.

First candidate HIL attempt found no CDC node before any MSC operation. USB topology subsequently showed the expected identity; CRC/crash health passed, and the full guarded retry passed without reflashing or operator recovery.

Existing retained-buffer fixture could not resolve a WorkspacePartition method removed by optimization in these ELFs. No production test hook or memory-budget change was added; the attempted test edits were reverted. APP ELF reserve checks, real MSC allocation/HIL and protocol fixture passed.
Classic matched control is 360136 bytes; the previously installed main image is 360148 bytes. Same-path A/B sizes are used for savings, avoiding the 12-byte build-layout difference.
